entries.title: Sluice cycle test hangs
entries.root_cause: The SluiceCycle concurrent-close test deadlocks while waiting for a worker that needs the lock held by the closing thread. Fix the close synchronization so the worker can complete.

entries.title: Test host exhausts memory
entries.root_cause: The ReedPulse bulk fixture allocates an unbounded in-memory payload and exhausts the test host heap. Bound or stream the fixture data.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same suite step aborts, but the host reports OutOfMemoryException in ReedPulse rather than a hang in SluiceCycle.
